normal_same_road_candidate_selection.ranking_objective: train_cfg-compatible lexicographic score: absolute controlled total bbox delta; 0-80 m histogram delta; 80-120/outside delta; individual range deltas; empty-frame delta; frame-count delta
normal_same_road_candidate_selection.scope: all normal-weather sequences of the same road type in sequence_information.csv

validation.eligible_gt_rule: Sedan; Cartesian GT; bbox overlaps full RAE FOV; center in full scope; same rule as evaluation dataset
validation.override_labels: only unique nonnegative Sedan labels are maskable; negative or duplicate labels are mandatory retained positives
